_about: Companies that share a name, or a name stem, with a company in data.js but are NOT that company. Edited by hand; no script writes this file.

Read by scripts/fetch_deals.py (deal-feed headline matcher), scripts/fetch_curated_lists.py (BuildList / Black Flag watcher and the HQ cross-check) and scripts/fetch_vc_portfolio_watcher.py (name-only holdings).

context_guards: a funding headline credited to this data.js company is dropped when the headline or its summary matches not_if, or fails to match only_if (case-insensitive regexes). only_if is for one-word names many companies share (Halo, Covenant, AIR): the story has to be about our company's field.

different_companies: `name` is a different company from every data.js record listed in `not`. A headline or list entry whose full name is `name` is never credited to those records. A data.js record whose own name is exactly `name` still matches normally.

common_word_names: one-word company names or name aliases that are also ordinary words or common acronyms. The deal matcher accepts one only where a name stands: not right after another capitalised word ('European Union'), never with a corporate suffix it does not own ('Union AI'), and, as a headline's first word or in a Title Case headline, only directly before the funding verb ('Built for war, Foo raises' is about Foo). scripts/sync_master_list.py prints new candidates.
